name: schools
description: Kennebec Valley Regional School Unit (fictional) school-district ledger: the student activity accounts the district holds in a custodial capacity, the cash collected into and disbursed from them, the federal programs and their costs, and the adopted and amended budget lines with their expenditures. Synthetic demo data; all money in integer cents. No student records are exposed; the controls reconcile activity accounts, federal costs and budget lines by code only.
domain: school districts: student activity funds (GASB 84), federal program costs (2 CFR 200) and budget variance
notes: Student activity accounts (activity_accounts) are GASB 84 custodial (fiduciary) funds the district holds for the student groups. An account's balance is its collections (activity_collections) less its disbursements (activity_disbursements); a negative balance means a group spent money it did not have.

A collection's exposure is the gap between collected_date and deposited_date. activity-deposits-late flags a collection deposited more than deposit_days days after it was collected, or not deposited at all (deposited_date is NULL); deposit_days is a parameter defaulting to 1, since student-activity manuals commonly require a deposit within one business day of collection.
A disbursement needs both the advisor and the principal approval (advisor_approved = 1 AND principal_approved = 1). activity-unapproved-disbursements flags any disbursement missing either.

A federal cost (federal_costs) must be charged inside its program's period of performance (federal_programs.period_start to period_end), per 2 CFR 200.403 and 200.309. A charge dated before period_start or after period_end is outside the period.
budget-variance compares paid expenditures against the amended budget per line, the same pattern as the municipal pack; the chart of accounts follows the Maine DOE Fund / Function / Object structure.

The student_records table (student names, grade levels and meal-eligibility status, all protected under FERPA) is intentionally omitted: this engine never reads student records. The controls identify accounts, programs and budget lines by code only.
